race.comment: MARIA LUCIA (9) trialled well coming into this prep but worked hard from the wide draw fresh before failing last start in the Placid Ark Prelude. Pike now rides from gate 1 back in trip and this looks a great platform for her to improve. Can get back to winning ways now. LONG SERVICE LEAF (5) won his latest trial after working through the grades last campaign and even jumped a $3.10 chance behind Bassett Hound just three starts back. Parnham sticks from the recent trials and he'll get every chance from the barrier. He appears the main danger. HAVE A CRACK (4) was smashed in betting, jumping the favourite and saluting on the back of an impressive trial coming in. Back to 1000m may be a niggle, but he was up to his best fresh and it's easy to think he could be better again now with the added fitness. DO I FEEL LUCKY (7) just missed last start and has claims on the back of that effort. KINGS COURT (2) can fire third-up with the claim and drop in trip coming in handy.
